verdicts.share: the midpoint (the samples' skew): centre the interval on the samples' mean

gate.bias: per decision on its latest arm, the 90% bootstrap interval (2,000 draws over the 800 worlds) of mean z_mid: above 0 or below 0 established; inside -0.08 to 0.08 closed; otherwise inconclusive (more worlds)
gate.cause: where established: mean (z_mid - z_mean)'s interval on the bias's side of 0 and mean z_mean's interval reaching 0: the midpoint (skew): centre the interval on the samples' mean; else for a bias above 0, the paired gap of the samples' means (latest minus all, value units) with its 90% interval below 0: the small pool: draw each sample from the latest fold's own rows; else read the worlds
gate.reported: the all-rows arms and the centre gap, beside the gate; each decision its own verdict
